WITH bond_order AS (
    SELECT
        bond_id,
        CASE LOWER(bond_type)
            WHEN 'single' THEN 1
            WHEN 'double' THEN 2
            WHEN 'triple' THEN 3
            WHEN 'aromatic' THEN 1.5
            WHEN '1' THEN 1
            WHEN '2' THEN 2
            WHEN '3' THEN 3
            WHEN '4' THEN 1.5
            ELSE 1
        END AS ord
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR206'
),
bond_ends AS (
    SELECT
        b.bond_id,
        bo.ord,
        MIN(c.atom_id) AS u,
        MAX(c.atom_id) AS v
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN bond_order bo ON bo.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR206'
    GROUP BY b.bond_id, bo.ord
),
heavy_bonds AS (
    SELECT be.u AS atom_id, be.ord AS w
    FROM bond_ends be
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = be.u
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = be.v
    WHERE UPPER(a1.element) <> 'H' AND UPPER(a2.element) <> 'H'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT be.v AS atom_id, be.ord AS w
    FROM bond_ends be
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = be.u
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = be.v
    WHERE UPPER(a1.element) <> 'H' AND UPPER(a2.element) <> 'H'
),
heavy_deg AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, COALESCE(SUM(hb.w), 0) AS deg
    FROM atom a
    LEFT JOIN heavy_bonds hb ON hb.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR206' AND UPPER(a.element) <> 'H'
    GROUP BY a.atom_id
),
heavy_valence AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id,
        CASE UPPER(a.element)
            WHEN 'C' THEN 4
            WHEN 'N' THEN 3
            WHEN 'O' THEN 2
            WHEN 'S' THEN 2
            WHEN 'P' THEN 3
            WHEN 'F' THEN 1
            WHEN 'CL' THEN 1
            WHEN 'BR' THEN 1
            WHEN 'I' THEN 1
            WHEN 'B' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END AS val
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR206' AND UPPER(a.element) <> 'H'
),
totals AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(MAX(0, hv.val - COALESCE(hd.deg, 0))), 0) AS total_h
    FROM heavy_valence hv
    LEFT JOIN heavy_deg hd ON hd.atom_id = hv.atom_id
),
explicit AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS explicit_h
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR206' AND UPPER(element) = 'H'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * e.explicit_h / NULLIF(t.total_h, 0), 4) AS percentage
FROM explicit e CROSS JOIN totals t;	----- bird -----	toxicology

WITH customer_2013 AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
        AVG(y.Consumption) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, CustomerID ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_2013
),
least_consumers AS (
    SELECT Segment, annual_avg_consumption
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM least_consumers
)
SELECT
    sme_avg - lam_avg AS sme_lam_difference,
    lam_avg - kam_avg AS lam_kam_difference,
    kam_avg - sme_avg AS kam_sme_difference
FROM pivot;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012 AS percentage_increase
  FROM seg
)
